_ignoreCommandNote: docs/, *.md and scripts/ are NOT excluded: /docs is generated from docs/*.md, docs/api/*.json, CHANGELOG.md and scripts/build-docs.mjs, so a change to any of them must trigger a redeploy or the published docs go stale.
